positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
•	Acted as Tech Lead for the DoorDash Drive Platform (third-party, white-label delivery integrations), owning technical vision, product-aligned roadmaps, system health, and cross-org execution for Tier-0 real-time distributed systems powering ~15% of DoorDash orders; served as one of the primary technical authorities for product and technical design reviews across the organization.
•	Designed and implemented the migration of Drive’s core event-processing pipeline from a monolithic service into a new dedicated service, partnering with central platform and logistics teams on a new Kafka event stream; served the majority of Tier-0 production flows, reduced event latency 6s → 1s, and enabled a new delivery assignment platform and product expansion.
•	Led and executed Drive’s Tier-0 migration from Aurora to CockroachDB, owning schema design and data migration, and coordinating Product, Storage, and Data teams; safely migrated all core tables for a real-time system while improving scalability, resilience, and AWS cost efficiency.
•	Built foundational SLOs, alerting standards, and runbooks across the Drive platform and drove adoption; regularly served as incident commander, led postmortems and remediation, and materially improved detection, response, and on-call quality.
•	Architected and led Drive platform data denormalization into downstream logistics and assignment systems, ensuring critical delivery data remained available during platform degradation; kept orders moving during Tier-0 failures, materially improving revenue and reliability outcomes.
•	Technical Lead for foundational ML-backed image verification systems for Drive deliveries, designing and implementing critical Drive-side components; partnered cross-functionally to roll out Drive’s first ML-powered equipment verification flows, delivering $2.2M+ annual impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led Drive’s CI migration from Jenkins to Buildkite using containerized test execution, partnering with central platform teams during rollout; reduced CI cycle times by ~75%.
•	Drove multiple cross-org ownership transfers for Tier-0 Drive systems during reorganizations, supporting new owners to ensure continuity and reliability.
•	Represented Drive in SOX compliance audits and Tier-0 enterprise partner engagements, providing technical guidance on platform behavior and integrations.
•	Mentored and sponsored engineers across levels, supporting successful promotions; partnered with managers on hiring and candidate closing to build strong engineering teams.
•	Tech Stack: Kotlin, Java, Python 3, MySQL, CRDB, Redis, AWS, Buildkite, Spinnaker, Jenkins, Cursor

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led development of a regulatory enforcement system for one of Airbnb’s largest markets, working with government stakeholders and third-party vendors on design, timelines, and trade-offs.
•	Executed a zero-downtime migration of a business-critical database to a new tech stack, reducing p99 latency by ~30% at ~5k QPS.
•	Reengineered the core framework that calculated and enforced home sharing regulations from a hard-coded system to a dynamic and db-backed platform; ​dramatically increasing the rate at which engineering could support new product launches by an order of magnitude.
•	Designed and implemented an offline data-pipeline that automated the calculation of hosts for Airbnb’s largest market who are eligible for tax regulations and made the data available online.
•	Tech Stack: Java, Ruby, MySQL, Thrift, Kafka, Redis, AWS, Buildkite, Spinnaker
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Technical Leadership · Real Time System Design · Scalable Architecture · Distributed Systems · Python (Programming Language) · Microservices · Distributed Databases · database migrations · Data Pipelines · Event Driven Programming · Java

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented key features and APIs, a real-time bidding (OpenRTB) server with supporting micro services; turned into a million dollar plus monthly business within 8 months.
•	Led the development of the initial architecture and framework for the micro-services that support the OpenRTB server.
•	Reengineered and improved the OpenRTB server to load all core model data from cache that is updated by an external process instead of loading from MySQL; reduced server CPU usage by 10%.
•	Integrated the OpenRTB server with four ad exchanges, helping bring in new sources of publisher ad supply for advertisers.
•	Tech Stack: Python 3, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, Tornado, Flask, Airflow, AWS, Travis CI, Spinnaker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led the redesign of the mobile app categorization data structures and targeting algorithms to incorporate hierarchical categories.
•	Led the development of a system that enabled geographic targeting of devices at country, province, state and city levels; former system only capable of country level targeting.
•	Reengineered and added new key features to the device segmentation API, allowing clients to precisely target higher quality segments of users; new features account for 20% of current advertiser spending and helped increase eCPM by 15%.
•	Designed and implemented a real-time system to notify advertisers when their daily campaign budgets are approaching their limits.
•	Reengineered and improved the data pipeline that scrapes app information from iTunes and Google Play stores; increased the number of apps scraped per day from 32k to 96k and increased the success rate of scraping an app by 20%.
•	Designed and implemented new data structures and endpoints to integrate and track non-game advertisers and publishers in the network, introducing new sources of advertising revenue.
•	Wrote a new Fraud API that improved the process and speed of reporting and blocking fraudulent accounts from 150 per day to 2,500 per day; contributed to an 80% reduction in monthly fraudulent publisher earnings, resulting in cumulative savings in excess of $1 million.
•	Led the migration of the MongoDB cluster from dedicated hardware to a shared cluster; resulted in a 75% reduction in monthly MongoDB hosting costs.
•	Tech Stack: Python 2, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Airflow, Flask, AWS, Jenkins
